candidates.title: Washington State Air Quality
candidates.publisher: Washington State Department of Ecology Open Data
candidates.description: The links on this page provide access to the Washington State Department of Ecology's Air Monitoring Network, which tracks various air pollutants at more than six dozen sites statewide. Visitors can filter and export historic data using the Site Report tool, and gather traffic-specific air pollutant data from the Seattle and Tacoma monitoring sites linked below.

candidates.title: GHG Reporting Program Publication
candidates.publisher: Washington State Department of Ecology Open Data
candidates.description: This dataset contains greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions data reported to the Washington State Department of Ecology from the state’s largest emitters. As of 2022, this dataset accounts for the majority of the state’s emissions and serves as an indicator of the statewide total. Ecology separately calculates the statewide emissions total through the Washington State Greenhouse Gas Inventory. Reported emissions vs. Covered emissions Some of the graphs showing this data distinguish between the total emissions reported to Ecology by large emitters called reported emissions and the subset of that total that is covered by the Climate Commitment Act called covered emissions. Reported emissions • These are the total emissions from large emitters: facilities, fuel and natural gas suppliers, and electric power entities that emit 10,000 metric tons of carbon dioxide equivalent (MTCO2e) or more annually. • These large emitters must report their emissions under WAC 173-441. candidates.title: Public Health Activities and Services - Compact View
candidates.description:
The Public Health Activities and Services (PHAS) data measures what public health does in the state and how much of it is done across all 35 local health agencies and the Department of Health in Washington State each year.  Activities measured fall under the following broad categories:
  Access To Care 
  Assessment 
  Communicable Disease 
  Communicable Disease: Immunization 
  Emergency Preparedness 
  Environmental Health 
  Healthy Families 
  Prevention and Wellness
More PHAS data is available at https://fortress.wa.gov/doh/phip/PHIP/Home.mvc
